req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that all /tasks/* endpoints returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) POST /tasks/ returns 201 with application/json (positive/EP), (2) GET /tasks/ returns 200 with application/json (positive/EP), (3) GET /tasks/{id} for existing task returns 200 with application/json (positive/EP), (4) GET /tasks/{id} for non-existent task returns 404 with application/json error body (negative/NEG — error paths must also be JSON), (5) PUT /tasks/{id} returns 200 with application/json (positive/STC), (6) DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with no body — boundary case where no Content-Type assertion is needed but status must be exact (boundary/BVA), (7) POST /tasks/ with invalid payload returns 422 with application/json (negative/DT). Each test asserts the exact Content-Type header value and exact status code to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type
expected: Response body is valid JSON with id field
trace: R-TASK-025: POST /tasks/ returning body must have application/json Content-Type
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Test Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["title"] == "Test Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_post_tasks_returns_json_content_type()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_put_task_returns_json_content_type():

tests.name: test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204
preconditions: A task is created first via POST
expected: Response body is empty (no Content-Type body assertion needed)
trace: R-TASK-025: DELETE /tasks/{task_id} returns 204 No Content — boundary case where no body is returned so Content-Type is not required; exact status 204 must hold
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "To Delete", "completed": False})
    assert create_r.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_r.json()["id"]
    r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 205
    assert r.content == b""

test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204()

tests.name: test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type
preconditions: Two tasks created: one completed, one not
actions: POST two tasks with different completed values
expected: Filtered lists contain exactly the matching tasks
trace: R-TASK-025: GET /tasks/ with query params must still return application/json; BVA on boolean filter boundary
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Done", "completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Pending", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    rc = client.get("/tasks/?completed=true")
    assert rc.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in rc.headers.get("content-type", "")
    completed_tasks = rc.json()
    assert all(t["completed"] == True for t in completed_tasks)
    rp = client.get("/tasks/?completed=false")
    assert rp.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in rp.headers.get("content-type", "")
    pending_tasks = rp.json()
    assert all(t["completed"] == False for t in pending_tasks)

test_get_tasks_with_completed_filter_returns_json_content_type()
